note: ADR-0298 §3 debt baseline. Two maps, both SHRINK-ONLY — the gate fails on anything NEW. `instanceScopePresence` records DECLARED owners that register from a constructor or a mount function, so the isolation audit cannot prove that their absence at runtime is clean. It is EMPTY as of L-712: all five declared owners now register as import side effects, checked by gate D6, so absence is provable and the runtime presence check has nothing left to catch. A future owner that registers from a constructor must be listed here again. `undeclaredStateCandidates` records files holding module-level project-scoped state with NO declared owner, found by the heuristic sweep in check-declared-project-scopes.ts. That list is the point of the exercise: every entry is a subsystem that could carry Project A's state into Project B today, and until ADR-0298 none of them was written down anywhere. Entries are triaged, not excused — LEAK-RISK entries need a declared owner; NOT-PROJECT-SCOPED entries need only a rename or a one-line confirmation to be removed.

undeclaredStateCandidates.apps/editor/src/engine/graphQueryBusHand: NOT-PROJECT-SCOPED (2026-08-12) — the sweep matched `const PENDING = new Map(...)`, the request-id-keyed result handoff for the three read-only graph verbs (`PENDING` word-matches the heuristic's `pending`). It is a per-dispatch correlation buffer, not project state: `dispatchGraphQuery` mints a fresh rid, dispatches, then reads AND deletes the entry on the very next line of the same awaited call, so the map is empty at rest and holds nothing keyed by project, element or level. A project switch has nothing to clear — there is no entry to leak unless `bus.executeCommand` throws AFTER the handler ran, and such an orphan is rid-keyed garbage no reader can reach (a bounded-memory nit, not a cross-project disclosure). The module's other column-0 state, `_ridCounter`, is a monotonic counter with no project content. This entry stops covering the file if the handoff ever grows entries that OUTLIVE a dispatch (e.g. a subscription or streaming result); that state would need a declared owner. Closes when CommandBus grows a typed return channel for read verbs and the handoff map is deleted.

The state it memoises is USER/DEVICE-scoped, not project-scoped, and the file's own header is the citation: "THIS FILE IS THE ONLY PLACE A PROVIDER KEY IS WRITTEN TO DISK. undeclaredStateCandidates.apps/editor/src/ui/ai/chatFacadeAttachme: NOT-PROJECT-SCOPED (2026-08-25, lane CHATATTACH58) - the sweep matched exactly ONE identifier, `let pending: ChatAttachment | null = null` (:107), the photograph riding with the NEXT chat message. It word-matches the heuristic on `pending`, the same false positive already recorded for graphQueryBusHandlers.PENDING. It is verifiably not project state: the object holds a `File` the USER just picked, the `RasterImage` the browser decoded from it, an object URL over that same File, and a promise resolving to the C108 reading. NO project id, NO element id, NO level id, and nothing read from any store - `setChatAttachment` takes a File and touches no runtime, and `runReconstruction` calls only `reconstructFacade` (pure) and `mapFacadeIRToPhotoBrief` (pure). Its real lifetime is ONE MESSAGE and it is enforced, not merely intended: `consumeChatAttachment()` clears the attachment on send even when the reading FAILED, and the per-turn photo is threaded as an explicit `ChatTurnFacts` parameter rather than read out of module state by `buildContext` - see L-10905 for why that parameter exists. note2026-08-23-ISO45: Lane ISO45, C13 project-isolation leak (ISSUE-LOG L-8100..L-8180). The gate was RED at 50 candidates against a baseline of 41. NINE files were over baseline and NONE was baseline-bumped to green: SIX were genuinely project-scoped and received a REAL `projectScopeRegistry.register` teardown owner in the module that owns the state (plantools.armedSelection, plantools.stairByWallsPlan, analysis.readModel, analysis.graphReadModel, diagnostics.lineworkProbe, views.underlayViewScope), which is why they leave this list by being FIXED rather than by being recorded; THREE are recorded above as NOT-PROJECT-SCOPED with the matched identifier named and checked one by one. `apps/editor/src/ui/ai/byom/byomDeviceStorage.ts` appeared mid-lane and is DELIBERATELY NOT TOUCHED HERE - it belongs to the concurrently-running BYOK lane, and classifying another lane's in-flight file from the outside is how a wrong reason gets written down as a decision. Two of the six were AUTHORED-BUT-UNWIRED rather than merely undeclared: `stairByWalls.__resetStairByWallsForTests` carried the comment 'Test seam + project-switch reset (C48 project isolation)' with zero project-switch callers, and `invalidateAnalysisReadModel`'s doc claimed it was 'Called on commit and on project load' while no load path called it.
